scope: Ordinary-play rendering optimization on the original Kairos ground, with first-use graphics preparation; no simulation, economy, enemy or asset change.
implementation: Original-map color and normal array layers are sampled only for positive normalized mask weights; stage reveal and blend order remain unchanged.
Initial shaders finish asynchronous compilation and opened-map, pod, hive and effect textures are uploaded during loading.
Flat double-sided effect sprites use one draw pass. An offscreen force-draw experiment was rejected after its stage-six sample regressed.

comparison.host: Ryzen 7 5800U / Radeon, local Chrome headless, 1440x900 DPR1, Normal difficulty, zero talents; samples are sequential and subject to host variation
comparison.standaloneSimulationDebtAfter: Approximately zero for all three opening samples
comparison.groundCanvasDiff: At 1440x900 on the same paused world, stage 1 sparse-versus-dense RGB was exact. Stage 6 differed on 0.00231% of pixels by more than one channel unit (mean absolute channel delta 0.00122); sparse-versus-sparse repeat also drifted by 0.00247%, so this small difference is within capture drift. This is not a human art review.

stress.fixture: 25 ordinary + 3 heroes + 300 enemies, real Kairos map, 12 wall seconds, development build, not natural campaign
stress.interpretation: The three local runs did not add simulation debt, but visual frame rate remains below 60 and this Terran fixture does not certify all races or prolonged play.

validation.offlineSave: three races passed, no HTTP requests or browser errors
validation.groundPixelComparison: stage 1 exact; stage 6 difference below sparse repeat drift

limits: Headless Chrome is display-paced near 60Hz and cannot demonstrate more than 60 FPS on a physical high-refresh display.
First ten seconds retain intermittent 180-233ms GPU/driver first-use stalls. The prototype offscreen preload did not improve them.
Stage 3-6 reference scenes are not normal successful campaign playthroughs; prolonged ordinary play and physical-device visual QA remain outstanding.
